name: 03 - Error Workflow
_note: Error workflow: DMs the developer in Slack (user U0C5S49GTPX) when a workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow fails (01, 02, 04). Kept out of the approvals/briefing channel on purpose: it is a developer alert. To route elsewhere, change 'Notify On-Call' (Send Message To: user/channel). An Error Trigger only fires for OTHER workflows, which is why this must be its own workflow.
